lts.banner: The WPF edition has entered long-term support (LTS): no new features will be added. We recommend the more modern and smoother cross-platform (Avalonia) edition.
lts.help: The WPF edition now receives security and crash fixes only, with no new features. The Avalonia edition runs on Windows, macOS and Linux and keeps receiving interface and interaction updates.

loadState.failed: ⚠️ Part of the configuration failed to load (retry later)

general.themeHelp: Switch between the dark and light interface (also /darkmode on|off)
general.languageHelp: The interface, error messages and command help switch immediately — no restart needed. The choice is stored in ui_state.json.
general.confirmDestructive: Ask for confirmation before commands with side effects (/clear, /clearcache)
general.confirmDestructiveHelp: On by default: prevents data loss when /clear is mistyped as /clearcache.

model.hubSourceHelp: Auto prefers the domestic mirror and falls back to the official site; you can also force one of them.
model.hubTokenHelp: Only needed for models that require authorisation. The token is stored in plain text in the configuration file — do not use it on an untrusted machine.
model.searchTip: Type a keyword and press Enter, for example qwen2.5 gguf
model.empty: Type a keyword and press Search to browse downloadable GGUF models.
model.registryTip: Models already downloaded into models/. The model currently in use cannot be deleted.
model.contextHelp: The smallest of the configured value, the model's training window and max_context, so the model is never over-asked.

automation.pickTip: Open a browser and click the element you want; the selector is generated for you
automation.pickRunning: ⏳ Waiting for you to click the element in the browser (press Esc to cancel)…
automation.pickTaskList: The task links in the task list
automation.pickTaskRow: The whole row that holds one task
automation.pickDetailFile: The attachment name on the task detail page
automation.pickLoginCheck: An element that appears only after signing in (for example the user name in the corner)
automation.templateTip: Pick a template to fill in a typical configuration, then adjust it to your site.
automation.wizardTip: Four steps: task list → next page → detail attachments → dry-run one task
automation.wizardStep1: Step 1: test the task list element
automation.wizardStep4: Step 4: dry-run one task (no result file)
automation.exportTip: Exports neither the login state nor the processed list or temp folder, so it is safe to share across machines.
automation.importTip: Importing does not carry over the safety protocol or the master switch; accept them on this machine.
automation.extensionsHint: Typical: pdf, docx for contracts · xlsx, xls for spreadsheets
automation.onlineHelpTip: Plain-language explanation of every field, a full example and a troubleshooting table, without leaving the app

market.searchTip: Type a keyword and press Enter; leave it empty to browse everything
market.empty: No skill is discoverable under this topic yet.
market.emptyHintTips: Want yours listed? Push a public repository containing skill.json and add the topic echodesk-plugin.

developer.modeHelp: When on: skill.json validation is relaxed (a missing echodesk.bundle only warns), verbose logging goes to skills_dev.log, and hot reload is enabled. It also turns on automatically when skills_dev/ contains plugins. Only validation strictness is relaxed — never the permission boundary.
developer.installExamplesTip: Copy the bundled Hello World and OFD reader examples into skills_dev/ to exercise the loader.
developer.scaffoldTip: Generates a minimal, spec-compliant skeleton (skill.json, entry file, language packs, README) that loads as soon as it sits in skills_dev/.
developer.manifestTip: The manifest can point at plugins anywhere, give them aliases, enable or disable them, set the load order and record trust. Relative paths are resolved against the program folder.
developer.hooksEmpty: (no plugin has attached an automation hook yet)
developer.panelsEmpty: (no plugin provides a panel yet. The Hello World example ships one — click “📦 Install example plugins”.)

about.ltsBody: The WPF edition has entered long-term support (LTS): from now on it receives security and crash fixes only, with no new features. We recommend the more modern and smoother cross-platform (Avalonia) edition — it runs on Windows, macOS and Linux, and its interface and interactions are still being updated.
